cohort: The study included preschool children at five years of age, comparing a group of 32 preterm infants with 381 term-born children.
finding: Mechanical ventilation at birth in preterm infants directly contributed to an increased risk of developmental disorders of the stomatognathic system, particularly dental hypoplasia, and non-breastfed children had a higher risk of developing malocclusion.
cross-section timing: When the children were five years of age
birth_weight: Collected from medical records; no specific range or criteria mentioned
gest_age: Preterm (<37 weeks gestational age) and term infants
